text.en:
There shall be established a secondary vocational school in the Municipality of Sto. Niño,
Province of South Cotabato, to be known as the Sto. Niño National School of Arts and Trades.
The school shall offer secondary education curriculum for vocational trade school courses.

Such sums as may necessary for the operation and maintenance of said school shall be provided
in subsequent General Appropriations Acts, until which time the operation of the institution as a national high
school shall be deferred.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
